Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

clothes — the things you wear. Example: My favourite clothes are jeans.
wear — to have clothes on your body. Example: In winter I wear a coat.
favourite — the one you like most. Example: My favourite clothes are jeans.
season — spring, summer, autumn or winter. Example: My wardrobe has got four seasons of clothes.
look — to seem, or to have a certain appearance. Example: It looks good.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My favourite clothes are ...
• In winter I wear ...
• What do you wear in summer?
• It looks good.
• My wardrobe has got ...
